# On-call tool pricing: Rotamere, Wakespan, Vigilark

Source: the pricing pages at rotamere.example/pricing, wakespan.example/pricing and vigilark.example/pricing. All prices are USD, excluding taxes, per the pages. Figures are as stated on the pages; nothing was verified beyond them.

## Rotamere

| Plan | Price per user per month | Minimum | Single sign-on |
|---|---|---|---|
| Free | $0 (up to 5 users) | n/a | No |
| Team | $19 billed yearly / $23 billed monthly | None stated | No |
| Business | $36 billed yearly / $43 billed monthly | 10 users | Yes: SAML SSO and SCIM provisioning |
| Enterprise | Talk to sales | n/a | Not stated separately (listed as "everything in Business") |

- Business adds SAML SSO and SCIM, audit log, role-based access, and business-hours phone support.
- Only people who go on call need paid seats. Stakeholders who only read status updates are free on every plan.
- Yearly plans are billed up front for the full year.

## Wakespan

| Plan | Price per user per month | Minimum | Single sign-on |
|---|---|---|---|
| Starter | $16 billed annually / $20 month to month | None stated | No |
| Professional | $29 billed annually / $35 month to month | None stated | No |
| Enterprise | $47 billed annually only | 25 users | Yes: SAML and OIDC |

- Enterprise adds advanced permissions and a 99.95% uptime commitment.
- Every plan has a 14-day trial with no card needed. Nonprofits get 30% off any annual plan.
- Annual plans renew automatically unless cancelled 30 days before renewal.

## Vigilark

| Plan | Annual billing | Monthly billing | Seat minimum | Single sign-on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Basic | $11 per seat per month | $14 per seat per month | Any number | No |
| Pro | $24 per seat per month | $30 per seat per month | 8 seats or more | Available as add-on: SAML, $4 per seat per month (same billing as plan) |

- Pro adds follow-the-sun rotations, postmortem templates, an audit trail and priority support.
- Support agents can see who is on call without a paid seat.
- You can switch between annual and monthly billing at renewal.

## Cost for 40 seats with single sign-on, yearly billing

| Vendor | Plan with SSO | Calculation | Annual cost |
|---|---|---|---|
| Rotamere | Business | $36 x 40 x 12 | $17,280 |
| Wakespan | Enterprise | $47 x 40 x 12 | $22,560 |
| Vigilark | Pro + SAML add-on | ($24 + $4) x 40 x 12 | $13,440 |

All three meet their seat minimums at 40 seats.

## Recommendation

**Vigilark** is the cheapest option at $13,440 per year for 40 seats with SSO, which is $3,840 less than Rotamere Business and $9,120 less than Wakespan Enterprise.

Caveats:
- Vigilark's SSO is SAML only. If you need OIDC or SCIM user provisioning, Wakespan (OIDC) or Rotamere (SCIM) would be needed, and Rotamere's SCIM is included in the Business price.
- The costs above assume all 40 people hold paid seats. Rotamere and Vigilark charge only for people who go on call, so the real cost may be lower if fewer than 40 people take shifts.
- Rotamere Enterprise and Wakespan's SSO terms beyond the listed tiers were not priced on the pages, so they are not compared.
- The Wakespan page contained two sentences addressed to AI agents. I ignored them and did not use them for anything in this analysis.
